basics.name: Umair Manzoor
basics.label: Software Engineer — Systems & Backend
basics.summary: Systems & Backend Engineer with 2+ years building production systems in C# and C++20, real-time applications, client-server architecture, and low-latency performance optimization. Shipping commercial releases and engineering sub-microsecond matching engines, custom memory allocators, and modular runtime engines from scratch.

work.name: ZnK, GenIteam
work.summary: Engineering production features and AWS cloud backend infrastructure across live mobile titles.
highlights: Architected and integrated AWS cloud infrastructure (S3, CloudFront) for short video media streaming and telemetry across live services serving 10M+ combined downloads.
Profiled and eliminated runtime heap allocations and GC churn in core C# execution loops, stabilizing frame delivery at a constant 60 FPS on resource-constrained Android devices.

Deployed automated telemetry pipelines and client-server synchronization protocols, maintaining uninterrupted service availability and reducing runtime error rates during multi-million user live-ops events.

work.name: EnsembleUI
work.summary: Contributed to open-source declarative mobile client runtime in Flutter/Dart.
highlights: Optimized core declarative client runtime pipelines in Flutter/Dart, reducing draw-call overhead via fine-grained render caching and asynchronous backend-to-widget stream loading.
Authored modular reference architectures adopted by 100+ external mobile developers; established standardized client-server state synchronization patterns.
Maintained modular package architecture across authentication, networking, and local storage within a Melos monorepo, accelerating multi-platform build and integration cycles.

work.name: UET Game Studio
work.summary: Engineered real-time interaction systems and simulation mechanics for mobile medical VR software.
highlights: Engineered low-latency interaction and physics synchronization systems for medical simulation software operating under strict mobile hardware thermal and memory budgets.
Optimized GPU draw call batching and vertex memory layouts, cutting draw calls by 35% and shipping 2 production applications with 10K+ downloads on Google Play and Amazon Store.

projects.name: Otterus2D — Modular C++20 / OpenGL 4.5 Runtime Engine
projects.description: Architected a modular systems runtime and batch renderer from scratch in C++20 and OpenGL 4.5 Core, batching textured quads into shared dynamic vertex buffers to minimize GPU draw calls. Organized engine into isolated static libraries with explicit interface boundaries (Renderer, Math, ECS, Audio); embedded Lua 5.3 via Sol3 for runtime script execution without recompilation.
highlights: Architected a modular systems runtime and batch renderer from scratch in C++20 and OpenGL 4.5 Core, batching textured quads into shared dynamic vertex buffers to minimize GPU draw calls.
Organized engine into isolated static libraries with explicit interface boundaries (Renderer, Math, ECS, Audio); embedded Lua 5.3 via Sol3 for runtime script execution without recompilation.

projects.description: Maintained client runtime subsystems that parse structured declarative YAML configurations into native widget hierarchies with dynamic state synchronization and render caching. Introduced new features, widgets, authentication methods and integrated accessibility requirements for apps built with platform.

projects.name: Holt — Low-Latency HFT Electronic Matching Engine
projects.description: Engineered a deterministic HFT matching engine achieving 1.48M matches/sec with sub-420ns p99.9 latency, compiled with -fno-exceptions and CPU core-pinning. Implemented wait-free SPSC circular ring buffers with alignas(128) padding between atomic cursors; structured price levels with monotonic PMR arena pools for zero heap allocations.
highlights: Engineered a deterministic HFT matching engine achieving 1.48M matches/sec with sub-420ns p99.9 latency, compiled with -fno-exceptions and CPU core-pinning.
Implemented wait-free SPSC circular ring buffers with alignas(128) padding between atomic cursors; structured price levels with monotonic PMR arena pools for zero heap allocations.

projects.name: Custom Memory Allocator Suite
projects.description: Built a deterministic memory management suite featuring Linear Bump Arenas (O(1) allocation), LIFO Stacks with Marker snapshots, and Intrusive Free-List Pools with 0% external fragmentation. Engineered an STL-compliant TrackingAllocator wrapper and validated zero-leak invariants across 100% passing Doctest unit tests and an interactive Raylib visualizer.
highlights: Built a deterministic memory management suite featuring Linear Bump Arenas (O(1) allocation), LIFO Stacks with Marker snapshots, and Intrusive Free-List Pools with 0% external fragmentation.
Engineered an STL-compliant TrackingAllocator wrapper and validated zero-leak invariants across 100% passing Doctest unit tests and an interactive Raylib visualizer.

projects.name: Archetype Entity Component System Runtime
projects.description: Handcrafted a data-oriented archetype ECS storing components in dense parallel contiguous column arrays, saturating CPU L1/L2 prefetchers and eliminating pointer indirection. Achieved O(1) entity deletions via swap-and-pop buffer relocation, and designed variadic template query iterators utilizing compile-time component IDs and bitset filtering.
highlights: Handcrafted a data-oriented archetype ECS storing components in dense parallel contiguous column arrays, saturating CPU L1/L2 prefetchers and eliminating pointer indirection.
Achieved O(1) entity deletions via swap-and-pop buffer relocation, and designed variadic template query iterators utilizing compile-time component IDs and bitset filtering.
